detail: Suntec REIT entered into FY2024 sale transactions for Suntec City Office strata units totaling S$58.3m at an average 24.5% above book value. S$41.9m of strata-unit sales completed in FY2024; the balance strata-unit sale completed on 6 Jan 2025. Independent valuation benchmark for the sold strata units was S$47.1m. Audited Note 6 separately states six strata units completed in FY2024, carrying amount S$34.402m and net gain S$14.992m; one further S$13.126m carrying-value unit was HFS at 31 Dec 2024.
